people.name: East_Gate
people.line: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, near the house of Shemaiah.

people.name: Immer
people.line: Man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Shecaniah
people.line: Israelite who confessed marrying a foreign wife

people.name: Shemaiah
people.line: Levite who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Zadok
people.line: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate made repairs.
translations.bsb: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house, and next to him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard of the East Gate, made repairs.
translations.kjv: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
translations.asv: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his own house. And after him repaired Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
